LBR.note: Document mentions no farming use of satellite data; GNSS surveying is for land.
Deed authentication is of land documents, not electronic identity of a person.

facts.fact: A Swedish Lantmateriet mission with the Liberia Land Authority reviewed and sought to improve the connectivity and functionality of the LLA Land Administration System and its Deed Verification and Scanning Modules, under a project strengthening the system.

The Liberia Land Authority's Director of Land Administration says trained surveyors will help densify the national geodetic reference network, laying the foundation for a National Cadastre that is still to be established.
